up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows for the human single-protein target CHEMBL4959 (Gastrin-releasing peptide receptor). Return the following columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Filter the results to include only exact activity values (standard_relation = '=') where pchembl_value is not null. Order the results by molecule_chembl_id and then by assay_chembl_id. Limit the output to 1000 rows.
sql:
SELECT
  a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  td.target_type,
  td.tax_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  act.standard_type,
  act.pchembl_value
FROM target_dictionary td
JOIN assays a ON td.tid = a.tid
JOIN activities act ON a.assay_id = act.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4959'
  AND act.standard_relation = '='
  AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
  md.chembl_id,
  a.chembl_id
LIMIT 1000
